title: Turn plans into progress.
headline:
Turn plans
into progress.
subhead: A clearer next step for every project
scene: Warm ivory backdrop. Right two-thirds shows one premium white desktop interface window in mild perspective with a simple cobalt vertical sidebar and four wide kanban columns labeled exactly Plan, Draft, Review, Ship. A few pastel blank task cards, no tiny body text. One floating cobalt checkmark tile foreground. Left third exact dark charcoal bold sans headline and small PATHWAY wordmark. Clean 3D UI illustration, realistic rounded corners and contact shadows, original concept.
